import Part, Sketcher
b = doc.addObject('PartDesign::Body','Body')
sk = b.newObject('Sketcher::SketchObject','Sketch')
sk.Support=(doc.getObject('XY_Plane'),['']) if doc.getObject('XY_Plane') else (b.Origin.OriginFeatures[3],[''])
sk.MapMode='FlatFace'
P=FreeCAD.Vector
for i,(a,c2) in enumerate([((0,0),(60,0)),((60,0),(60,40)),((60,40),(0,40)),((0,40),(0,0))]):
    sk.addGeometry(Part.LineSegment(P(a[0],a[1],0),P(c2[0],c2[1],0)))
for i in range(4): sk.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint('Coincident', i, 2, (i+1)%4, 1))
pad = b.newObject('PartDesign::Pad','Pad'); pad.Profile=sk; pad.Length=10
doc.recompute()
result=(pad.Shape.Volume, [e.Length for e in pad.Shape.Edges][:4], pad.State)

import Part, Sketcher
b = doc.addObject('PartDesign::Body','Body')

    sk.addGeometry(Part.LineSegment(P(a[0],a[1],0),P(c2[0],c2[1],0)))

result=(pad.Shape.Volume, [e.Length for e in pad.Shape.Edges][:4], pad.State)
